info.title: api-hub Wrapper API
info.description: Wrapper API for Slack and S3-compatible storage.

post.description: Updates a message posted by the authenticated bot. Requires chat:write. Supply channel and the ts returned by Slack.

Copies within the configured S3 endpoint, including between buckets, preserving source metadata. Replaces an existing destination key. Single CopyObject only; no automatic multipart copy for objects larger than 5 GB.
Reads the current object or the specified version.
Replaces all tags on the current object or specified version; does not merge. Maximum ten tags with unique keys.
Deletes the tag set, leaving the object intact.

post.summary: Upload an object and notify Slack
post.description: Uploads Base64 data, then posts text and a presigned GET URL to Slack. HTTP 200 with uploaded=true and notified=false means the file was saved but Slack failed; inspect notification_error and retry only /slack/message. No rollback or automatic retry. The URL uses RUSTFS_S3_ENDPOINT, which must be reachable by recipients; its lifetime starts when signing before upload. This endpoint does not observe uploads made by other clients.

post.summary: Stream a binary object to S3 with bounded memory
post.description:
Accepts Content-Length or chunked bodies. Buffers at most 8 MiB of payload
per part and uploads sequentially using S3 multipart upload for large objects.
Aborts the multipart upload on receive or S3 errors. Maximum 10000 parts.
Content-Type is preserved, defaulting to application/octet-stream.

post.summary: Issue a 15-minute GET URL for internal viewer media
post.description: Only pdfs/hitomi/*.pdf, *_prev.jpg and pdfs/videos/*.mp4. Uses RUSTFS_S3_BROWSER_ENDPOINT. URL is a bearer capability; response is no-store. Existing internal-network access restriction still applies. No per-user authentication is provided.

200.description: Signed URL; Range is not signed and can vary

get.summary: Redirect to a newly signed viewer GET URL

post.description: 202 confirms durable acceptance, not Slack delivery. Unique producer/event_id/channel; identical retry returns the same ID. Changed payload conflicts. Requires api_hub migration and a notification worker. Optional file references an image previously persisted in pdfs/hitomi-notifications/. File bytes are not stored in PostgreSQL. File preparation retries before sharing; uncertain share results require manual verification. File IDs are exposed as slack_file_id.
